title: Sterboul-Deming Graphs: Characterizations
summary: A graph is said to be a Sterboul--Deming graph if $KE(G)=\emptyset$, that is, if every vertex of $G$ belongs to a posy or a flower (structures introduced by Sterboul, Deming, and Edmonds). These graphs can be regarded as the structural counterparts of König--Egerváry graphs. In this paper, we present several characterizations of Sterboul--Deming graphs. We first study the case of graphs with a perfect matching and with a unique perfect matching, providing a constructive algorithm to obtain the decomposition $(SD(G), KE(G))$.
